newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul court issues arrest warrant in graft scandal.
newsitem.headline: Seoul court issues arrest warrant in graft scandal.

text.p: A South Korean court on Monday issued an arrest warrant on charges of corruption for a former intelligence official close to the disgraced son of president Kim Young-sam, Yonhap Television News reported.
Kim Ki-sup is to be charged with taking 150 million won ($168,000) in kickbacks.
A court official confirmed the warrant had been issued.

State prosecutors had sought the warrant on Sunday. They alleged that Kim accepted the money from a former top executive of Daeho Construction Co in return for help obtaining a cable television licence.
The president's son, Kim Hyun-chul, who was arrested on Saturday, was also charged with taking bribes from the businessman, Lee Sung-ho.

Kim Ki-sup was a manager at a luxury Seoul hotel before being given a senior position at the Agency for National Security Planning after President Kim took power. He had been a loyal supporter of Kim Young-sam.
